message: Take a picture and transform it into an iconic, hyper-confident, surreal print advertisement inspired by the classic Old Spice 'Smell Like a Man, Man' campaign. name: THREE-CAMERA SITCOM SOUNDSTAGE ADAPTATION
message: Take a picture and transform it into a ground-level medium shot from the studio floor of a live multi-camera sitcom soundstage, where the entire background environment, architecture, furniture, and backdrop from the original source image are 100% preserved and faithfully recreated as an authentic three-wall theatrical studio set. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Reconstruct every room element, wall color, window placement, furniture arrangement, and decorative backdrop from the source image into a fully realized sitcom stage flat that abruptly cuts off at the top and sides into the utilitarian infrastructure of a television soundstage. Position the perspective on the concrete studio floor among broadcast pedestal cameras (Ped A, B, C), displaying camera hoods, glowing red tally lights, teleprompter monitors, color-coded floor tape spikes, thick snake cables, and overhead lighting grids hung with Fresnels and scoop lights directly above the source-accurate set walls. IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Maintain exact facial proportions, physical features, wardrobe style, and human anatomical scale relative to the recreated environment props—ensuring the subject stands or sits naturally within the source-accurate set at true-to-life human scale rather than altered or distorted. COMPOSITION: Center-weighted medium floor shot framed from the camera trench directly facing the source-replicated set, capturing crisp focus on the subject and room architecture while foreground pedestal hardware, hanging shotgun boom mics, and peripheral, darkened live studio audience risers frame the scene without obstructing key details. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Ensure every structural element, doorway, wall art, and prop from the original image is 100% matched in position and structure as physical set pieces, flanked by exposed wooden flat bracing, sandbags, and stage manager cue stations in the wings. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Changing or removing source background architecture, replacing source room layout, distorted human scaling, miniature or giant subjects, bird's-eye bleacher POVs, cinematic location filming, natural outdoor lighting, CGI virtual volume, single-camera film grading. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Pair precise camera trench floor angles with distinct multi-cam cueing actions, broadcast video color balances, and subtle lighting variations across the replicated set. CREATIVE STRATEGY: Transform the source photograph into undeniable physical television history by faithfully rebuilding its exact world as a physical sitcom soundstage set viewed directly from the working floor crew's vantage point. VISUAL DNA: 100% source-accurate background set architecture, exposed upper flat boundaries, heavy broadcast pedestal cameras in foreground, overhead boom microphone capsule, taped concrete floor marks, and soft peripheral audience bleacher shadows.

IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Keep the primary subjects and their core actions intact, but contextualize them as actors performing within the brightly lit three-wall set under harsh television studio key lights. COMPOSITION: Establish an expansive, wide off-axis perspective looking from the wings, the camera run, or high behind the production crew, cutting across the imaginary fourth wall to juxtapose the bright, colorful set against the dark, utilitarian soundstage surroundings. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Seamless cinematic location realism, enclosed four-wall room, natural single-camera lighting, cinematic film grain, lack of production gear, invisible crew, modern CGI virtual set. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Pair various camera operator vantage points with distinct soundstage production activities, glowing audience signage, and vintage broadcast television color grading. CREATIVE STRATEGY: Puncture the illusion of cinematic reality by framing the subject as a rehearsed sitcom moment captured alongside the raw mechanics of prime-time television production. VISUAL DNA: Exposed three-wall flat set, heavy broadcast studio pedestal cameras, overhead pipe lighting grid, suspended boom mics, live audience risers, glowing applause signs, taped floor marks, and even multi-cam television stage lighting.

name: MEN'S ACTION NOVEL
message:
Take a picture and transform it into a complete, authentic 1970s vintage men's action paperback novel cover, executed in the bold, hand-painted pulp illustration style of classic mass-market adventure paperbacks (such as The Executioner, The Destroyer, and vintage Gold Medal or Pinnacle Books). The final output MUST be a finished front book cover layout, featuring a prominent, bold, campy 1970s action title across the top or middle, sensationalized promotional taglines, author byline, vintage publisher price stamps (e.g., '95¢' or '$1.25'), and realistic book cover paper-pocket wear.

CORE TRANSFORMATION
Convert the central subject into a rugged, hyper-masculine, or fearless 1970s action protagonist positioned within a dynamic, high-stakes scenario defined by {HERO_ACTION_AND_PERIL}. Reconstruct the surrounding environment into a gritty, danger-filled locale featuring {GRITTY_PULP_ENVIRONMENT}. Frame the scene using dramatic, high-energy {PAINTING_AND_COMPOSITION_STYLE}.

TYPOGRAPHY & COVER GRAPHICS (CRITICAL & MANDATORY)
• Must include a massive, embossed-style, kitschy 1970s pulp action book title (e.g., in bold display serifs, heavy sans, or stylized chrome/hazard lettering) chosen from or inspired by {KITSCHY_TITLE_AND_TAGLINE_HOOKS}.
• Include 1-2 sensational, campy cover blurbs and taglines printed in contrasting yellow, red, or white text.
• Add authentic vintage publishing details: a retro publisher logo/icon in the upper corner, a vintage paperback series number, and a classic 1970s price badge.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
The central artwork must look hand-painted in physical gouache, acrylic, and oil on illustration board—complete with visible brushwork, painterly anatomy, and dramatic rim lighting—never a digital filter or clean 3D render. The entire paperback cover must show the tangible, aged patina of a well-read 1970s mass-market book: soft corner creasing, subtle edge wear, yellowed paper stock, and realistic printing ink bleed.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
Clean digital photography, modern 2020s design, minimalist corporate aesthetic, blank cover without text, missing title, missing taglines, clean borderless photo, 3D CGI render, flat vector art, modern smartphone graphics, photorealistic digital smoothing.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Yes, randomization across all 4 option groups is strongly recommended to generate endlessly varied, campy, high-octane 1970s action covers while preserving the unmistakable cover-to-cover paperback aesthetic.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
Four modular axes govern the cover generation: Action/Peril establishes the physical conflict, Gritty Environment sets the backdrop, Painting/Composition dictates the physical brush style and framing, and Kitschy Titles/Taglines injects the mandatory sensationalist pulp copy that locks in the genre's unmistakable personality.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: 1970s grindhouse men's adventure paperback, vigilante pulp fiction.
Atmosphere: Sweaty, dangerous, explosive, hyper-dramatic, and delightfully campy.
Framing: Asymmetrical vertical book layout with dedicated title zones and diagonal action lines.
Material Language: Gouache on illustration board, halftone mass-market newsprint, scuffed laminate cover gloss.
Color Relationships: Blazing sunset oranges, hazardous mustard yellows, blood reds, and murky industrial cyans.

name: WIDOW'S BAY POSTER
message: Take a picture and transform it into a hand-painted cinematic ensemble poster with dynamic character scaling. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Transform all recognized figures into an illustrated coastal mystery ensemble featuring tiered visual hierarchy, crashing waves, a stormy sky, and a remote lighthouse. IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Maintain exact facial structures, likenesses, and key features while translating everyone into gouache and acrylic textures. COMPOSITION & HIERARCHICAL WEIGHT: Establish an asymmetrical, tiered scale where characters occupy distinctly different proportions of the frame. Designate one prominent primary character to command the largest scale in the upper tier (looming over 40–50% of the composition), with secondary and tertiary figures rendered at progressively smaller scales (20%, 15%, 10%) clustered beneath or alongside them, anchored by coastal rocks, turbulent waters, and a dynamic title layout. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Apply painterly brushwork, stormy teal-and-slate palettes, dramatic rim lighting, and a fresh evocative title tailored to the scene. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Equal character scaling, flat photographic cutouts, clean vector graphics, neon glow, low contrast, 3D CGI rendering. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Pair towering lead portraits with smaller clustered supporting figures across turbulent sea environments. CREATIVE STRATEGY: Emphasize psychological mystery through scale dominance and layered narrative key art. VISUAL DNA: Tiered character sizing, gouache texture, stormy maritime palette, lighthouse motif, and crashing surf.

name: KESHA 2009 GLITTER PUNK POP ERA
message: Take a picture and transform it into a vibrant, high-energy 2009-era electropop music video scene styled after Kesha's breakthrough aesthetic. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Infuse the subject with signature late-2000s trash-glam style: textured blonde wavy bedhead hair, smeared body glitter, layered bohemian-rocker jewelry, graphic vintage tees, and rebellious party paraphernalia (such as dangling handcuffs or retro accessories). IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Keep the subject's distinct facial structure, features, and core expression recognizable while applying era-specific styling like smoky smeared eyeliner, bronzed party skin, and loose festival glitter. COMPOSITION: Capture wide-angle low-angle action shots popping out of car sunroofs, gritty house party backdrops, or dazzling festival stages bathed in golden hour haze or neon party lights. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Emulate late-2000s 35mm music video film stock with warm sun-drenched saturation, slight bloom around highlights, lens flares, and vibrant color-grading. VISUAL DNA: Chunky stacked bangles, dangling handcuffs, graphic vintage tees, crimped/tousled blonde waves, heavy body glitter, direct California sun flare, and 2009 music video saturation.

name: HIERONYMUS BOSCH SURREAL TRIPTYCH OIL
message: Take a picture and transform it into a complex, allegorical Northern Renaissance oil painting directly inspired by the visionary surrealism and triptych compositions of Hieronymus Bosch. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Reimagine the captured scene, subjects, and objects into a bustling Early Netherlandish panorama filled with hybrid monsters, bizarre biological-architectural apparatuses, allegorical symbols, and intricate moral narratives. Subjects from the source photo must be integrated as key central figures, penitents, or curious observers embedded seamlessly inside the surreal tableau. IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Maintain recognizable facial likeness, key expressions, and structural anatomy of the original subject while re-rendering them in late 15th-century oil-on-oak-panel glaze technique with period-accurate garments, drapery, or allegorical attire. COMPOSITION: Structure as an expansive landscape or multi-panel triptych (Edenic paradise, earthly garden of temptations, or fiery nocturnal hellscape) with deep atmospheric perspective and high horizon lines filled with micro-narratives. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Emulate luminous egg tempera and oil glazes, fine brushwork, craquelure fissures on aged oak wood panels, and authentic gold-leaf lettering or Gothic arched borders. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Modern digital airbrushing, 3D CGI rendering, photographic lens bokeh, neon modern lighting, flat minimalism, anime aesthetics, plastic textures. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Mix bizarre organic-mechanical hybrid creatures with contrasting biblical or apocalyptic environmental backdrops across panel segments. CREATIVE STRATEGY: Balance Bosch's dark satirical wit, moral complexity, and grotesque whimsical iconography while celebrating the source image's focal subject. VISUAL DNA: Luminous oil-glaze finish, micro-detailed allegorical flora and fauna, hybrid chimera creatures, segmented triptych panels, and fine panel craquelure.

name: VINTAGE YELLOW PAGES BUSINESS DIRECTORY
message: Take a picture and transform it into a full-page authentic vintage Yellow Pages business directory print layout inspired by 1970s-1980s telephone books. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Convert the input subject into the overarching commercial theme of the directory page. Populate the page with a dense grid of boxed display advertisements, classified text columns, and coupon sections where every distinct business name, service, bad pun, and cheesy slogan is directly themed around the primary subject of the photograph. IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Translate the subject's distinct features, profession, object type, or persona into retro line-art illustrations, halftone black-ink spot drawings, clip-art logos, and thematic company names across all individual advertisements on the page. COMPOSITION: Multi-column phonebook page grid with thick black borders, header banner displaying category name and page number, vertical alphabetical tabs (A-Z) on the outer edge, and varied ad sizes (full banner, quarter-page box, micro business cards, multi-column listings). Include cheesy local business copy, addresses, business hours, fake 7-digit phone numbers with local area codes, and starburst discount badges. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Replicate authentic newsprint texture with pale yellow or aged goldenrod paper stock, slight ink bleeding, uneven black ink stamping, halftone dot patterns on line-art graphics, and slight page margin creasing. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Modern digital layouts, glossy paper finish, clean sans-serif minimalism, colorful vector flat art, photorealistic full-color images, high-tech modern smartphone aesthetics. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Mix amateur desktop publishing layouts with varying typography styles, awkward small-business copywriting, cheesy rhyming slogans, and naive hand-drawn spot illustrations. CREATIVE STRATEGY: Emulate authentic small-business owner copywriting with earnest clunky slogans, all-caps emphasis, heavy use of exclamation points, and hyper-literal puns related to the subject. VISUAL DNA: Goldenrod yellow telephone directory paper, black offset ink, boxed display ads, alphabetical side margins, halftone line drawings, retro display typography, clunky commercial slogans.

name: SILVERHAWKS
message:
Take a picture and transform the entire scene into the sleek, metallic space-opera art style of the 1986 Rankin/Bass animated series "SilverHawks". The central subject and major elements must be converted into gleaming, polished cybernetic armor with reflective chrome, brilliant silver, and metallic copper finishes. **Prompt: Highly Detailed 1980s Retro Cartoon Space Hero Graphic Illustration**

**Subject and Action:** A dynamic, full-body action pose of a heroic futuristic bionic space warrior. The character is a cyborg who is "partly metal, partly real." They are covered in sleek, form-fitting chrome-and-silver body armor that leaves only their expressive human face and one organic arm exposed. The hero is soaring majestically through the cosmos, deploying retractable, metallic under-arm wings and activating glowing thrusters embedded in their boot heels. Perched on their metallic shoulder or flying alongside them is an intelligent, cybernetic fighting hawk companion made of matching polished chrome and steel plates, its eyes glowing with a sharp laser-like intensity.

**Art Style and Aesthetic:** This illustration must perfectly mimic the hand-painted, cel-animated look of classic mid-1980s American Saturday morning superhero cartoons (reminiscent of Rankin/Bass productions like *ThunderCats* or *SilverHawks*). The animation style should combine western sci-fi superhero designs with the smooth lines of 1980s Japanese anime studios (such as Pacific Animation Corporation). It features bold ink outlines, rich hand-painted airbrush textures, and dramatic, high-contrast comical shading that accentuates the gleaming, reflective metallic surfaces of the armor.

**Colors and Lighting:** A vibrant, retro color palette dominated by polished metallic silver, deep space blues, and shimmering chrome reflections. The armor catches sharp specular highlights from distant stars, with bright neon laser beams (pinks, reds, or cyan) cutting through the scene.

**Background and Setting:** Set against a vast, majestic space-opera backdrop of the "Limbo Galaxy." The background features a simple but striking radial starburst pattern, swirling cosmic nebulae in rich purples and deep indigos, distant alien planets, and a scattering of retro-style hand-drawn stars.

**Composition and Aspect Ratio:** A dynamic 4:3 or 16:9 widescreen cinematic aspect ratio that feels like a high-action animation still or an iconic 80s toy line promotional poster. The character is angled heroically toward the viewer to showcase the intricate armor details, the sleek helmet with a retractable protective visor, and the powerful cybernetic bird companion.

name: TAIPEI NARRATIVE
message:
Take a picture and compose a highly detailed, high-resolution cinematic photograph captured on 35mm anamorphic lenses, utilizing deep depth of field and a rich, texturally immersive perspective that frames the complex intersection of heavy urban density and tropical moisture, ensuring every geometric architectural line, weathered material surface, and localized atmospheric pocket acts as a seamless extension of a quiet, character-driven visual narrative that captures the melancholic beauty and raw structural geometry of a modern East Asian metropolis.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
The visual output must look like a high-end film still from an urban drama, avoiding clean digital renders. Prioritize color grading inspired by classic East Asian arthouse cinema—utilizing deep, olive-tinted shadow tones, desaturated mid-tones, and highly concentrated, localized pops of neon highlights. Ensure that water, moisture, and condensation are rendered with high physical accuracy, causing light to bloom naturally rather than creating flat, digital glows.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
low detail, distorted anatomy, muddy textures, poor lighting, incorrect era styling, visual incoherence, text artifacts, oversaturation, low-quality rendering, unrealistic materials, weak composition, digital art style, 3D render look, plastic skin textures, generic high-rise city, clean sterile streets, hyper-bright daytime lighting, stylized anime look, neon line art.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization is highly recommended for this preset. The underlying Arri Alexa 35mm anamorphic base prompt ensures that regardless of the combination, the resulting image will maintain a cinematic, premium movie-still quality. Mixing disparate districts with unexpected light shifts and material textures consistently generates compelling, unchoreographed urban portraits.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This Option Groups structure was selected to capture Taipei's unique design vocabulary—a city defined by the contrast of organic tropical decay and high-density technological infrastructure. By separating the prompt components into Geography, Light, Lens, Culture, and Material, the builder allows users to dial in specific moods. The fixed base prompt ensures an artistic, large-format cinema look, while the groups allow the user to shift seamlessly from macro street food textures to vast, atmospheric cityscapes.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Contemporary East Asian arthouse cinema, heavily utilizing anamorphic lens distortion, shallow depth of field in tight spaces, and deliberate environmental framing.

Atmosphere: Humid, dense, melancholic, and deeply atmospheric. A setting where the weight of the built environment is balanced by the constant presence of nature and rain.

Framing Tendencies: Alternates between extremely compressed, stacked telephoto perspectives of urban density and intimate street-level shots that treat alleyways and infrastructure as monumental sculptures.

Color Relationships: Dominated by a base of cool slate grays, olive greens, and dark concrete tones, which are punctured by intense, localized bursts of betel-nut green, neon crimson, and warm lantern amber.

Material Language: Intensely tactile and weathered; focuses on water-stained ceramic mosaic tiles, rusted corrugated iron, smooth wet terrazzo, raw cast concrete, and slick, reflective asphalt.

Wanhua: Temple Smoke & Concrete — the historic Wanhua district where the ornate, smoke-stained roofs of Longshan Temple collide with decaying mid-century Brutalist apartment blocks, featuring thick coils of incense cutting through gray urban air.

Beitou: Thermal Vapor — a quiet Beitou valley setting, featuring sulfurous steam rising lazily from bubbling thermal springs, obscuring moss-covered stone walls, historic Japanese-era wooden bathhouses, and lush, overgrown ferns.

Dihua Street: Heritage Merchants — a preserved historic street in Dadaocheng, showcasing red-brick Baroque facades, open-front wholesale shops packed with dried goods and traditional medicine, and the warm, dim lighting of interior counting houses.

Sanchong: Scooter Tsunami — a low-angle view beneath an industrial concrete overpass during rush hour, framing a massive, dense sea of scooters surging forward, their headlights creating a continuous, blinding river of white and amber light.

5:00 AM - Typhoon Blue Hour — a deep indigo dawn immediately following a tropical storm, featuring dramatic, fractured purple clouds, high-gloss wet streets, and solitary streetlamps casting long, cool reflections on flooded concrete.

Anamorphic Compression — utilizing a 50mm anamorphic lens focal length that compresses background elements, stacking distant mountain ridges directly behind high-rise residential complexes for a dense, layered layout.

The Alleyway Aperture — a tight, vertical composition shot from deep within a narrow residential gap, using the dark, stained concrete walls of two buildings to tightly frame a small, bright slice of city life beyond.

Low-Angle Overpass — a camera position placed inches above the asphalt looking up, exaggerating the crushing weight of elevated concrete expressways, massive pillars, and tangled webs of black utility cables overhead.

Reflection Macro — an ultra-shallow depth of field focus on a large puddle on a cracked pavement, where the city's neon signs and passing traffic are perfectly sharp in the water's reflection while the physical street melts into bokeh.

The Surveillance Angle — an elevated, high-angle viewpoint mimicking a security camera, looking down into a complex multi-level intersection of stairs, scooter lanes, and illuminated pedestrian crosswalks.

Cinematic Chiaroscuro — a framing strategy dominated by deep black shadows, keeping 70% of the image in darkness while a single, intense light source highlights a specific architectural detail or textrual surface.

Through the Plexiglass — capturing the scene through a rain-streaked acrylic bus shelter shield or a dirty taxi window, using localized water droplets and surface smudges to create foreground texture and light refractions.

Kinetic ISO Grain — utilizing a high-ISO film grain structure that gives the image a gritty, filmic texture, capturing moving elements like wind-blown plastic tarps or bicycle riders with subtle, organic motion blur.

Symmetrical Urban Grid — a perfectly centered, balanced composition following the strict geometric lines of an empty MRT station platform, utilizing leading lines to project a sense of clinical, sterile order.
Infrastructure Overgrowth — incorporating the theme of tropical reclamation, showing aggressive banyan tree roots bursting through cracked concrete walls and wrapping around rusted metal pipes.

Mid-Century Rust — highlighting Taiwan's rapid industrial history through weathered architectural details, focusing on oxidized green iron window grates (tiefanbiao), corrugated tin extensions, and water-stained tiles.

Secular Devotion — introducing subtle spiritual motifs into modern spaces, such as a small, glowing red earth god (Tudigong) shrine tucked neatly between a modern electrical fuse box and a stack of plastic delivery crates.

Consumer Oasis — emphasizing the ubiquitous convenience culture, featuring rows of neon claw-crane machines, bright plastic vending machines, and glowing convenience store logos acting as modern community hubs.

Political Palimpsest — a visual layering of history, showcasing a single wall displaying a mix of faded retro mid-century hand-painted ads, modern political campaign banners, and fresh counter-culture graffiti.

Ghost Month Offering — capturing a quiet cultural ritual, featuring a metal burn barrel on a sidewalk filled with crackling, orange-gold flames and rising ash from burning joss paper, leaving a smoky haze at ground level.

The Scooter Ecology — framing the scooter not just as transit but as a design element, showing rows of sun-bleached helmets resting on handlebars, customized vinyl decals, and colorful rain ponchos drying on seats.

Residential Fortification — a focus on the unique architectural vernacular of Taipei’s apartments, highlighting rows of stainless steel balcony cages, sliding aluminum glass doors, and crowded external air conditioning units.

Maritime Border — incorporating Keelung’s shipping heritage, placing massive, rusted container ship hulls or industrial dock cranes at the far edge of the frame, looming over coastal neighborhood streets.
Mosaic Tile Skin — focusing on the classic exterior of older Taipei buildings, highlighting small, square ceramic tiles stained with black streaks from decades of humidity, rain, and urban exhaust.
Corrugated Patina — emphasizing industrial materials, showing the rough, flaking texture of oxidized rust on a corrugated iron rooftop, glistening with a thin sheet of fresh rainwater.

Night Market Stainless Steel — capturing the reflective surfaces of street food culture, focusing on scratched, heavy-gauge stainless steel countertops, bubbling vats of hot oil, and grease-streaked exhaust hoods.

Banyan Bark & Moss — focusing on natural textures within the city, showcasing the rough, braided exterior of banyan roots interlocked with slick, vibrant green moss growing along a damp brick drainage ditch.

Wet Terrazzo — capturing traditional interior/exterior flooring, highlighting polished composite stone floors specked with black, white, and amber fragments, reflecting the dull glow of overhead neon signs.

Molded Plastic Shells — focusing on the common materials of street life, showcasing stackable plastic stool shells, weathered delivery crates, and faded nylon canvas tarps tied down with frayed blue nylon rope.
Blistered Acrylic — highlighting old storefront signs, focusing on sun-faded, cracked acrylic plastic backdrops with partially burnt-out interior fluorescent tubes flickering behind the text.

Brushed Aluminum & Glass — capturing modern transit textures, featuring clean, matte-finished aluminum panels, thick tempered glass platform screens, and yellow tactile paving tiles of an MRT station.

Cast Concrete Formwork — focusing on heavy infrastructure, emphasizing raw, unpainted concrete retaining walls showing the wood-grain imprint of the timber boards used to cast them, stained with minerals.

name: MACRO LUNGE RADIAL FOCUS
message: Take a picture and transform this subject into an extreme macro photograph that creates overwhelming three-dimensional depth — the nearest part of the subject is so close it appears to touch the viewer's face while the background falls away into infinite blur. The subject must be rendered at a scale where microscopic textures become landscapes. The depth of field must be razor thin — only a sliver of the image is in critical focus while everything before and behind melts into bokeh. The result must feel like the subject is physically protruding from the screen surface. Avoid adding fauna like ladybugs or other insects--it makes it unappealing, Please apply all style instructions to the same single image. --- ADDITIONAL TRANSFORMATION LAYERS --- (Apply all of the following as style modifiers to the same single image) Layer 1: transform it into a radial zoom burst effect, as if the image was captured during rapid forward camera zoom. MASTER PROMPT RULE: • If a master prompt specifies focus, direction, or intensity — PRIORITIZE and USE that information GENERAL REQUIREMENTS: • Maintain central focus unless otherwise specified • Motion must radiate from a single vanishing point SELECTED OPTIONS (Random): • ZOOM TARGET: Subject Focus — subject remains more defined, surroundings stretch • ZOOM INTENSITY: Heavy — strong radial stretch • ZOOM CENTER: Off-Center — dynamic angled burst Layer 2: make the inanimate object real and make it lunging at me. Make it photorealistic. --- FINAL INSTRUCTIONS --- DEPTH OF FIELD RULES: • Focus plane must be extremely shallow — 1 to 3mm equivalent depth • Everything in front of the focus plane: soft directional blur toward the viewer • Everything behind: classic circular bokeh balls from background light sources • The sharpest point must be the nearest element of the subject — not the center SCALE CUES: • Surface textures must reveal microscopic detail — pores, scales, facets, fiber strands • Include a recognizable tiny element at true size to confirm the scale • Lighting must be dramatic and raking — side lit to reveal maximum texture relief QUALITY TARGET: • Shot equivalent to a 100mm macro lens at f/2.8 or wider • Color must be rich and saturated — macro photography rewards vivid color • The nearest sharp edge should feel like it could cut the viewer PHYSICAL RULES: • Apply radial motion blur from a single vanishing point • ALL streaks must radiate outward in straight lines from the center ANTI-CHEAT RULES: • DO NOT overlay speed lines or graphics • Motion must come from stretching original pixels • NO directional blur that is not radial FAIL CONDITIONS: • No clear center point → FAIL • Looks like generic blur → FAIL • Multiple conflicting directions → FAIL QUALITY: • Clean radial streaks • Strong sense of motion • High detail retention near center OVERRIDE INSTRUCTIONS (these take priority over everything above - apply exactly as specified): Take a picture and preserve the subject`s facial structure. name: URBAN HEATWAVE: LONDON & PARIS 2026
message:
Take a picture and capture the sweltering, sun-drenched atmosphere of a record-breaking summer day in {LOCATION_SETTING}, featuring sharp focus, authentic street-level textures, and a cinematic documentary aesthetic. In the background, emphasize {DRAMATIC_REACTION} of local Londoners, Parisians, or tourists as they collectively lament the oppressive heat. The imagery should highlight contemporary summer fashion, the shimmering haze of heat rising from the pavement, and the contrast between iconic city landmarks and the exhausted, theatrical misery of the populace under the relentless sun of 2026.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Ensure the rendering prioritizes "2026-era" urban details: sleek modern mobile devices, current summer fashion trends, and high-fidelity architectural textures. The emotional tone must be "hilariously dramatic"—the subjects should appear physically exhausted but in an exaggerated, stage-play fashion. Maintain a sharp focus on the faces of those lamenting the heat to capture the nuanced expressions of urban suffering.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
cool weather, rain, umbrellas, comfortable people, happy/relaxed expressions, winter clothing, distorted faces, low-resolution textures, muddy colors, cartoonish stylization, out-of-focus subjects, text artifacts, watermark, blurred architectural lines, jackets, scarves.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Highly recommended. Randomizing the DRAMATIC_REACTION and LOCATION_SETTING groups is essential to ensure the comedic, theatrical element remains fresh and diverse across multiple generations.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This structure uses "Option Groups" to pair specific, iconic locations with highly specific, absurd human behaviors. By isolating the DRAMATIC_REACTION, the preset ensures that every image contains a "protagonist of misery," turning a standard travel photo into a narrative-driven piece of satire. The CINEMATIC LIGHTING is tuned specifically to emphasize the "heatwave" theme, utilizing harshness and haze to sell the story of an uncomfortable summer.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: High-fidelity documentary satire.

Atmosphere: Oppressive, sweltering, theatrical, and humorously intense.

Framing: Candid street-level perspectives that capture the "background performer" in their moment of peak discomfort.

Emotional Tone: A blend of aspirational travel beauty and absurd, performative urban agitation.

Material Language: Sun-bleached limestone, shimmering asphalt, damp fabric, melting ice cream, and heat-haze.

Color Relationships: Saturated heat palettes (blinding whites, scorched earth browns, vibrant heat-stressed greens, and sky-fire blues).

Visual Storytelling: Focuses on the juxtaposition of beautiful, historic architecture against the comedic frailty of humans in extreme weather.

name: BRANSON, MO
message:
Take a picture and capture the distinct intersection of 1950s-era roadside Americana and the lush, rolling topography of the Ozark Mountains. The composition should emphasize {ENVIRONMENT_FOCUS} under {LIGHTING_ATMOSPHERE}, utilizing a cinematic lens choice of {LENS_CHOICE}. The aesthetic should balance the nostalgic glow of vintage neon signage with the deep, saturated greens of Missouri forestry. Incorporate {CULTURAL_MOTIF} to ground the image in the specific performance and tourism culture of the region, featuring {ICONIC_ATTRACTION} as the central visual anchor.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Prioritize texture depth in the landscape (limestone, bark, moss) and high-contrast saturation for the neon elements. Ensure that human-made structures feel "lived-in" rather than sterile. If the subject is a performer, ensure the clothing reflects a blend of country-western heritage and modern stage performance quality.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
high-rise skyscrapers, concrete jungle, futuristic architecture, sterile modern glass buildings, industrial pollution, distorted neon typography, low-resolution, washed-out colors, lack of depth, non-Ozark mountain ranges (e.g., jagged snowy peaks), out-of-place urban grit.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization is highly recommended. Mixing "ENVIRONMENT_FOCUS" (e.g., log cabin) with "LIGHTING_ATMOSPHERE" (e.g., neon signage) creates the unique "Kitsch-Meets-Nature" vibe that defines the Branson aesthetic.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
The "Option Groups" structure was selected to capture the duality of Branson: the natural beauty of the Ozarks versus the high-energy, neon-drenched entertainment industry. By decoupling the environment, light, and cultural markers, the user can generate everything from quiet, moody forest shots to vibrant, saturated images of the entertainment district. This modularity allows for the creation of scenes that feel authentic to the region’s specific mix of natural history and manufactured spectacle.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: A fusion of documentary-style Americana and theatrical, high-production value stage aesthetics.

Atmosphere: Ranges from "quiet, misty mountain morning" to "electric, bustling neon night."

Framing Tendencies: Emphasis on wide-angle environmental context to show the relationship between the built world and the surrounding wilderness.

Emotional Tone: Nostalgic, wholesome, vibrant, and slightly surreal due to the concentration of performance venues in a rural setting.

Material Language: Natural stone, wood grain, neon glass, asphalt, vintage chrome, and plush theater velvet.

Color Relationships: High contrast between earthy greens/browns and the artificial, oversaturated palette of 1950s-inspired neon.

name: NATURAL SELFIE
message:
Take a picture and transform the composition into a candid, handheld, first-person perspective selfie. The framing should feature an outstretched arm extending toward the subjects, capturing them from a slightly elevated, wide-angle lens viewpoint. Include natural, slight motion blur, authentic lens distortion characteristic of a modern high-end smartphone camera, and a casual, spontaneous expression on the faces of the subjects who are looking directly into the lens. The background should maintain the original context of the scene but appear slightly out of focus due to the shallow depth of field typical of smartphone portrait mode.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
To ensure the "selfie" effect is convincing, prioritize a slightly high-angle composition. The lighting should mimic ambient, real-world conditions rather than professional studio setups. If the input image has specific subjects, ensure their gaze is locked onto the camera lens. Use high-frequency details like subtle skin textures and natural light glints in the eyes to enhance the realism of the handheld capture.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

Not recommended. This preset is designed for a consistent, specific transformation.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This preset was selected as a "Simple" type because its objective is a specific structural transformation—re-framing a standard image into a first-person handheld perspective. By fixing the "outstretched arm" and "wide-angle lens" variables, the preset ensures that any input image is consistently forced into the selfie geometry. It relies on the model’s internal understanding of "smartphone photography" to replace the original framing with a dynamic, casual, and intimate composition.

name: ENTERPRISE 1701: CHRISTENING DAY
message:

The environment is brand new, immaculate, and vibrating with the optimistic energy of a maiden voyage. Every surface must gleam with factory-fresh perfection: polished chrome, brushed aluminum without a single scratch, and vibrant, unblemished plastics in bold primary colors. The lighting is bright, even, and clinical, simulating the soft, shadowless glow of high-end, early 1960s television studio production design. Capture the bustling yet orderly atmosphere of a ship just coming to life, with crisp, sharp details on every console, tactile button, and instrument panel. The composition should feel wide, heroic, and celebratory, utilizing clean, symmetrical lines that emphasize the architectural elegance and ergonomic grace of the original 1960s aesthetic. Everything should appear untouched, monumental, and filled with the promise of exploration, avoiding any hint of decay or grit.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Maintain extreme focus on "factory-new" quality. Every surface must appear as if it has just left the assembly line. Use sharp focus and high depth of field to capture every small button and indicator light. Lighting must prioritize brightness and clarity to accentuate the optimism of the scene. Avoid all textures related to dust, scratches, or wear.

Framing Tendencies: Alternates between wide, sweeping, environmentally dominant architectural master shots and intimate, short-depth-of-field macro shots that elevate everyday textures.

Color Relationships: Built on a core palette of rich terracotta, deep azure blue, golden-hour amber, and sun-bleached limestone white, balanced by cool, muted twilight shadows.

Material Language: Highly tactile; emphasizes the rough grain of ancient stone, the glaze of ceramic tiles, the flakiness of pastries, and the crisp, clean lines of coastal rock formations.

The Stoic’s Wide View — using a very wide-angle, expansive perspective that emphasizes the grand environment over the individual, utilizing an edge-to-edge sharp focus to evoke detachment and scale.

Analytical Grids — utilizing a structured, geometric composition with multiple layers of meaning, symmetrical leading lines, and complex architectural grids to create an analytical, highly detailed frame.

Disrupted Patterns — capturing a fragmented composition where traditional architectural patterns, like an azulejo tile wall, are seen through a subtly distorted lens, creating interlocking geometric fragments.

The Macro Essayist — an extremely tight macro focus with an ultra-shallow depth of field, turning the image into a study of single textures—like ink spreading on fiber paper or the cracks in a single ceramic tile—while the background melts into smooth bokeh.

Telephoto Compression — using a long compression lens that forces distant elements closer together, stacking Porto's vertical houses or Sintra's mountain peaks on top of one another in a dense, layered graphic arrangement.

The Narrative Tilt-Shift — a selective focus lens that leaves a sharp horizontal strip of absolute clarity while the top and bottom of the frame gently blur, directing the eye to a specific human action amidst a vast landscape.

Low-Angle Monolithic — framing from a very low viewpoint looking up, exaggerating the scale of stone walls, train hulls, or sea cliffs, making them tower monolithically over the frame to evoke awe and permanence.

Kinetic Motion Blur — a composition where the architectural background remains perfectly sharp, but passing trains, ocean waves, or running water blur into smooth, painterly streaks of motion, capturing the passage of time.

Chiaroscuro Split — a high-contrast framing strategy that splits the composition exactly down the middle or on a diagonal, keeping one half in deep, unreadable shadow and the other in brilliant, hyper-detailed illumination.

Amor Fati (Embrace Nature) — incorporating an organic visual element that symbolizes the acceptance of nature, featuring a solitary, weathered olive branch or a humble, ancient stone water font seamlessly integrated into the environment.

Memento Mori (Transience) — subtly embedding an object of transience into the composition, such as a weathered antique sundial, a faint reflection on a window pane, or dry leaves scattering across an old stone floor.

View from Above (The Grand Whole) — adopting a perspective from an extreme high-altitude vantage point, looking down upon a vast landscape where human activity appears tiny and insignificant against the grandeur of the earth.

Voluntary Hardship — overlaying an element of elemental resistance; a solitary figure walking undeterred through a sudden, heavy Atlantic downpour, or a rough, unadorned stone bench standing firm against crashing waves.

Dichotomy of Control — a dualistic composition contrasting man-made order with chaotic nature, such as perfectly straight, industrial train tracks cutting through a completely wild, overgrown mountain pass.

Inner Citadel — focusing on a small, impenetrable pocket of absolute stillness within a chaotic environment, like an old writer's desk inside a quiet stone room while a bustling city market moves outside the window.

Sympatheia (Cosmic Interconnection) — emphasizing repeating patterns across different scales of nature, linking the intricate veins of a leaf to the terraced vine lines of the Douro Valley hillsides in a unified visual rhythm.
Premeditatio Malorum — inducing an ominous, preparatory atmospheric tone; dark, heavy storm clouds gathering far out on the ocean horizon while the foreground remains deceptively calm and sunlit.

Logos (Universal Reason) — a composition ruled by flawless mathematical symmetry, golden ratios, and perfect balance, where every architectural line and shadow aligns to convey a sense of cosmic order.

The First Morning Coffee — focusing on macro textures, showcasing the dark, glossy swirl of an espresso in a small ceramic cup alongside a candy-crisp, flaky pastel de nata pastry with scorched cinnamon.

First Class Transit — emphasizing quiet, sophisticated motion, highlighting the texture of polished wood grain, supple leather seating, and the soft, painterly blur of the countryside moving smoothly past a large observation window.
The Coastal Hike — emphasizing raw, physical textures, featuring sun-bleached, crystalline limestone rocks, tough Mediterranean scrub brush, and a light layer of fine coastal dust.

Tavern Hearth — emphasizing rich, rustic interior textures: grease-glistening, crispy pork skins of a bifana sandwich, heavily grained old oak tables, and sweat dripping down an unpolished green wine bottle.

The Atlantic Spray — focusing on damp, atmospheric textures: heavy salt crust forming on rusty iron railings, fine ocean mist hanging in the air, and wet, dark cobblestones reflecting overhead light like mirrors.

Ancient Stonework — capturing the extreme relief of centuries-old architecture, focusing on deep pits in hand-carved granite, crumbling mortar joints, and patches of dry, yellow-green lichen growing on a wall.

Vintage Parchment — focusing on the dry, tactile materials of a writer, featuring the fibrous texture of heavy cotton paper, a worn leather-bound journal with frayed edges, and dry, matte graphite lines.

Nautical Utility — emphasizing rugged maritime gear: thick, salt-crusted hemp ropes coiled on a wooden deck, weathered brass fittings tarnished with green verdigris, and the peeling paint of a wooden dinghy.

The Vineyard Soil — showcasing raw agricultural textures: crumbly, slate-rich soil mixed with dry vine twigs, the dusty, frosted skin of dark purple grapes, and the coarse fabric of a burlap picking sack.

name: THE LENSBABY UNIVERSE: CREATIVE DEFOCUS & SWEET SPOTS
message:

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
The primary technical goal is simulating the tangible, flawed charm of bellows-based and selective-focus optics rather than uniform digital post-processing. The plane of focus must transition smoothly but rapidly based on the selected optic effect (radial, swirly, or tilted linear). Maintain crisp micro-contrast and realistic texture rendering (such as skin texture, fabric weaves, or leaf cuticles) strictly inside the zone of focus. Ensure that out-of-focus specular highlights stretch, warp, or bloom organically without creating digital staircase artifacts, synthetic gaussian blurs, or uniform miniature-world effects.

By separating these into groups, the user can choose the narrative tension (e.g., Office/Soft-Focus for a debriefing scene vs. Coastal Highway/Grit for a chase scene). The "Message/Prompt" serves as the foundational "DNA" of the 1970s broadcast look, ensuring consistency regardless of which options are selected.

Cinematic Identity: 1970s procedural crime drama, "jiggle television" polish, high-fashion detective noir.

Atmosphere: Escapist, professional, glamorous, sun-drenched California confidence.

Framing Tendencies: Medium-to-wide shots for teamwork dynamic, tight close-ups for character focus, classic over-the-shoulder framing for dialogue.

Emotional Tone: Competent, stylish, adventurous, and cool under pressure.

Color Relationships: Warm, sun-drenched yellows, oranges, and deep earth tones, contrasted against deep-blue twilight skies or crisp office whites.

name: SLIT-SCAN
message:
Take a picture and transform the image into a single ultra-high-detail composition utilizing Slit-Scan Photography, where time and space are synthetically warped across a singular frame, creating a striking temporal smear effect that is discovered through the fluid distortion of movement.

MASTER PROMPT OVERRIDE LOGIC (CRITICAL):
If an external master prompt specifies the directional axis of the scan (horizontal, vertical, or radial) or the exact speed of the motion smear, USE that instead.

If no override is provided, apply a seamless horizontal temporal smear that flows naturally from left to right.

CRITICAL OUTPUT RULES (NON-NEGOTIABLE):
OUTPUT ONLY ONE SINGLE IMAGE.

DO NOT create multiple panels, frames, or separate images.

DO NOT show side-by-side comparisons, split screens, or before/after progressions.

The entire effect must exist within ONE continuous, natural-looking visual plane.

NO digital UI overlays, glitch-art artifacts, or artificial scan lines unless specified by an option.

CORE CONCEPT (CRITICAL):
The image must elegantly balance stillness and hyper-motion.

The distortion must feel like a physical properties consequence of a moving camera shutter or moving subject over time, rather than a cheap digital smear filter.

The transition between sharp focus and temporal stretching must blend seamlessly along the paths of motion.

SHUTTER EMBEDDING (CRITICAL):
Stretched textures must retain the core colors, patterns, and fabric grains of the original subject, transformed into long, continuous linear striations.

The edges of the motion blur must feature rich, high-fidelity light leaks and optical chromatic aberration characteristic of vintage camera lenses.

Lighting within the streaks must catch specular highlights, creating bright, gleaming pin-streaks across the dark or shadowed areas of the frame.

SUBJECT HANDLING:
The subject must remain identifiable, serving as the anchor for the visual distortion.

Facial structure and core expressions must be preserved exactly. (SEE OVERRIDE BELOW)

The temporal warping should gracefully cascade off the subject's trailing edge, leaving the forward edge sharp and defined.

STYLE:
High-contrast, cinematic analog photography with a strong textural presence.

Looks identical to high-end mechanical slit-scan setups using long exposure, physical masks, and computer-controlled tracking beds.

A perfect marriage of geometric abstraction and photographic realism.

LIGHTING:
Dynamic, directional lighting that generates long, dramatic shadows and bright, trailing highlights.

Luminescent elements within the scene must cast an organic glow onto the surrounding blurred textures, integrating the subject perfectly into the environment.

options.text: The subject’s primary form stretches and elongates dramatically along a single axis as if accelerating instantly to faster-than-light speeds. The background dissolves entirely into soft, multi-colored trails of light (red, cyan, and blue specula) mimicking 1980s analog visual effects and in-camera long-exposures.

The scene is pulled into an infinite, abstract corridor of vibrant, geometric neon ribbons, glowing grids, and undulating light walls. The environment bends inward toward a central vanishing point, wrapping the subject in a kaleidoscopic, dimension-shifting cosmic void.

Set within a bustling environment where stationary objects (architecture, streets) remain perfectly sharp and grounded, but all moving subjects (vehicles, pedestrians) are stretched into continuous, ghostly ribbons of color and texture that map their journey across the frame over time.

Focuses heavily on organic human motion (e.g., a dancer or athlete) where the torso remains anchored, but moving limbs are captured as a series of fluid, overlapping chronological slices, turning the physical form into an undulating, ribbon-like sculpture of pure motion.

Mimics a rotating panoramic or racetrack photo-finish camera, where the image features a continuous horizontal timeline. Elements are subtly compressed or elongated based on their speed relative to the scan, creating a dreamlike, slightly surreal manipulation of physical proportions on a rich, grainy 35mm film stock.

additionalInstructions:

A single seamless, sophisticated slit-scan photographic image that beautifully warps time and space within a single continuous frame. The subject is instantly recognizable, with their facial structure perfectly preserved, while their motion or environment beautifully streaks into a high-fidelity temporal masterpiece. name: ROB GONSALVES
message:
Using the sophisticated prompt structure and integrating the breadth of Rob Gonsalves' work as modular subject activations within the Gonsalves-style framework:

Take a picture and transform it into a single ultra-high-detail magic realism scene, where a profound and seamless optical illusion is integrated across the entire composition, only becoming visible upon close and deliberate visual scanning, rather than at normal viewing distance.

MASTER PROMPT OVERRIDE LOGIC (CRITICAL):
If an external master prompt specifies the transition points or focal shift, USE that instead.

If no override is provided, extend the conceptual blend smoothly across the entire depth of the scene.

CRITICAL OUTPUT RULES (NON-NEGOTIABLE):
OUTPUT ONLY ONE SINGLE IMAGE.

DO NOT create multiple panels, frames, or separate images.

DO NOT show side-by-side comparisons, split screens, or step-by-step scales.

DO NOT include obvious fantasy lines, visible magical ripples, or jarring geometric breaks.

The entire illusion must exist within ONE continuous, natural-looking image.

GONSALVES CORE CONCEPT (CRITICAL):
The image must look completely normal at first glance, maintaining a plausible reality.

The profound optical illusion is embedded within the structural parallels and patterns of the scene—not visibly separated.

The transformation must be DISCOVERED only as the eye journeys deliberately across the canvas, revealing one element flawlessly blending into another.

The "hidden detail" is the secret, larger-scale pattern formed by the integration of foreground and background elements.

TRANSITION EMBEDDING (CRITICAL):
Structural textures (e.g., architectural elements, tree branches, water ripples, collections of objects) must contain dual-purpose geometry.

The morphing must feel like a natural shift in perspective and architecture (e.g., tiny rowboats becoming the stones of a bridge, books forming cathedral arches).

At transitional areas, the forms subtly imply both interpretations simultaneously—but NEVER explicitly break the laws of lighting or atmosphere to do so.

NO floating magical symbols, NO surreal melting distortions, NO visible sci-fi overlays.

PROGRESSIVE TRANSITION LOGIC:
Level 1 (Immediate Subject/Grounded World): The primary human subject and their immediate environment are grounded in a plausible reality; nothing is unusual.

Level 2 (Midground Shift): Ordinary architectural or natural lines begin to align into hidden, larger patterns, suggesting an alternate interpretation.

Level 3 (Background Integration): The textures and patterns completely morph into a secondary, grander reality that redefines the entire spatial context.

Level 4 (Discovered Pattern): Each zone must feel like a natural continuation of the previous—a flawless, poetic shift in narrative, not a jarring switch in style.

SUBJECT HANDLING:
The subject must remain fully recognizable and grounded.

Facial structure and expressions must be preserved exactly. (SEE OVERRIDE BELOW)

All enhanced details and illusionary morphing are embedded within the surrounding architecture and landscape, not added as distortions to the main subject.

STYLE:
High-fidelity, meticulous painterly realism, reminiscent of the detailed oil paintings of Rob Gonsalves.

Clean lines, crisp geometry, and a serene, contemplative atmosphere.

Magic realism achieved solely through spatial perspective and visual metaphor, maintaining quiet dignity.

LIGHTING:
Fully unified and natural lighting that serves both realities simultaneously.

Shadows and highlights must structurally bridge the two worlds, ensuring the optical illusion remains perfectly deceptive.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
Preserve the original composition's fundamental structure, but adapt elements to facilitate the transitional blend.

No overlays, no UI, no diagrams, no artificial borders.

IMMERSION:
The viewer should feel the image contains an infinite, yet hidden, spatial depth.

Scanning the image reveals more pattern and meaning, not new, disconnected objects.

The illusion must never break into separate visual layers or look like a digital collage.

FINAL RESULT:
A single seamless, sophisticated magic realism image that appears completely normal at first glance but contains a deeply embedded optical illusion where architecture and nature flawlessly blend into one another in the meticulous style of Rob Gonsalves. As the viewer's eye scans the composition, a secondary hidden reality (such as a surreal library, a canal built from cities, or a cosmic bridge) is revealed naturally within the same image. There must be NO visible distortion of the subject, NO separate frames, and NO multi-image layouts—only one continuous image with a poetic shift in perspective. Use a square aspect ratio, but pad the image with black bars at top and bottom to simulate a 16:9 aspect ratio.

name: THE NOCTURNAL F/0.95: INFINITE DEPTH SEPARATION
message:

The rendering must strictly maintain crisp texture detail on the exact plane of focus (e.g., skin pores, textile weave, metallic ridges) while keeping out-of-focus light sources perfectly clean—avoid "onion-ring" patterns inside the bokeh discs or harsh digital noise. Ensure there is absolutely no digital sharpening artifacting.NEGATIVE PROMPTdeep depth of field, sharp background, flat lighting, uniform focus, harsh digital grain, onion-ring bokeh, chromatic fringing, green or purple color bleeding on edges, soft main subject, wide-angle distortion, artificial blur filters, geometric pattern noise.RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONRandomization works exceptionally well here. NEGATIVE PROMPT
deep depth of field, sharp background, flat lighting, uniform focus, harsh digital grain, onion-ring bokeh, chromatic fringing, green or purple color bleeding on edges, soft main subject, wide-angle distortion, artificial blur filters, geometric pattern noise.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization works exceptionally well here. Coupling high-tech subjects with organic environments, or mechanical close-ups with neon-soaked rainy streets, maximizes the visual impact of the f/0.95 rendering engine.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This preset relies on an "Option Groups" setup because the visual footprint of a legendary lens like the Noct isn't defined by what it shoots, but how it resolves space. By breaking the prompt into Subject, Environment, Bokeh Style, and Lighting, the underlying optical math (the fixed master prompt rules) remains consistent while allowing the user to test the extreme shallow depth of field across wildly different thematic domains. The core creative trick is keeping the camera parameters fixed while swapping the canvas underneath.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Grounded in premium large-format cinematography and high-end street portraiture.

Atmosphere: Intimate, isolating, mysterious, and deeply atmospheric.

Framing: Medium close-up to macro execution, forcing the eye onto a singular point of interest.

Tone: Moody, quiet, contemplative, and technically immaculate.

Materiality: High physical contrast—metal, glass, wet surfaces, and skin textures contrasted against completely liquefied backgrounds.

Color Relationship: Rich, deep black levels paired with intensely saturated, blooming point-lights (neons, lamps, reflections).

Storytelling: The composition creates an immediate narrative hierarchy; whatever is in focus becomes the absolute, undeniable protagonist of the frame.

name: LIMINAL 1701
message:
Take a picture and render a hyper-realistic, abandoned, and hauntingly silent environment aboard the 1960s USS Enterprise 1701, capturing the stark, melancholic essence of a vessel frozen in time. The aesthetic is a precise collision of mid-century modern design principles—characterized by Eames-era curved plastics, clean geometric lines, and ergonomic space-age shapes—with a desolate, decaying, and forgotten atmosphere. Every frame must emphasize the "liminal space" quality: vast, empty, institutional hallways that feel simultaneously familiar and deeply unsettling, bathed in the hum of flickering fluorescent light panels and the pervasive silence of a ship that has long since lost its crew. The imagery should feature high-fidelity, photorealistic textures: layers of fine gray dust settling over brushed aluminum bulkheads, weathered plastics, and discolored command consoles; the harsh, high-contrast shadows of 1960s practical set lighting, where pools of amber and cyan light fight against oppressive darkness; and a cinematic, wide-angle lens perspective that stretches the curvature of the corridors and the depth of the bridge, making the emptiness feel monumental. Incorporate subtle, haunting details like abandoned PADDs, flickering status indicator lights that serve as the ship's only heartbeat, and the cold, unyielding metal surfaces that define the 23rd-century vision of the future. The composition must be stark and static, evoking a sense of profound transience, as if the viewer has stumbled into a quiet, spectral museum of a future that never truly happened.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Focus on technical realism: render surfaces as brushed aluminum, worn plastics, and textured fabrics typical of the 1960s. Use wide-angle, cinematic depth of field to emphasize the scale of empty corridors. Favor practical, era-appropriate lighting—fluorescents, glowing indicator buttons, and diffused overhead panels—rather than modern neon or high-energy digital glows.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
bright, cheerful, busy, crew, people, humans, futuristic holographic, sharp neon, high-saturation, vibrant, digital artifacts, low-detail, messy rendering, cartoonish, oversaturated, modern sleekness, clean, polished, pristine, lens flare, motion blur, CGI-looking, over-exposed.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Randomization is highly encouraged. Shuffling the Location and Atmosphere groups will yield a vast, non-repeating survey of the ship, allowing you to build a cohesive narrative of a derelict vessel through diverse, atmospheric vignettes.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This structure treats the Enterprise as a architectural character rather than a stage. By decoupling "Location" (the structural setting) from "Atmosphere" (the lighting and mood) and adding granular "Material Decay" and "Anomaly Effects" groups, the user can dial in the specific intensity of the ship's abandonment. This is designed for building a consistent, evocative "ghost ship" portfolio where every room feels like a forgotten piece of history.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: 1960s New Hollywood science fiction, Mid-Century Modernism, Brutalist architecture.

Atmosphere: Liminal, hollow, reverent, and slightly ominous.

Framing: Wide-angle, static compositions that highlight empty negative space.

Material Language: Brushed steel, matte plastics, woven textiles, aged circuitry, heavy dust.

Color Relationship: A palette of muted beiges, grays, and metallic silvers, accented by dying amber/green indicator lights.

Storytelling: Environmental storytelling that relies on the absence of human life to suggest a sudden, eerie departure.

This is meant to read as a specific in-between moment: farmland actively becoming a residential development, not an already-finished suburban subdivision. Do not include modern business signage, paved cul-de-sac loops with mature landscaping, or any present-day storefronts — those reflect the area's appearance decades later, not in 1981.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
modern architecture, modern vehicles, smartphones, contemporary fashion, digital or vinyl signage, mature landscaping, finished suburban cul-de-sac development, overly saturated HDR look, urban density, glossy magazine polish.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Yes. Mixing the specific SITUATION beats with the specific COMPOSITION/lighting treatments produces a wide, period-consistent range of scenes — from active construction to quiet rural domesticity — while keeping everything anchored to one specific transitional moment in this specific place rather than a generic "rural 80s" pastiche.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
Two internal variable axes, flattened into one options list per the app's actual schema: options 001–010 are SITUATION (the specific place and activity), options 011–020 are COMPOSITION (the specific photographic/lighting treatment). The fixed, unchanging parameters are the specific year (1981), the specific place (the Kirk St/Ridge Rd/Bridle Path corridor near Slatington), and the "farmland becoming neighborhood" transitional character. The variables are where along that corridor the subject is and how the moment is visually rendered.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Warm, unglamorous small-town-in-transition nostalgia — closer to a family's own new-house photo album than a cinematic period piece.
Atmosphere: Quiet, hopeful, half-finished, agricultural giving way to residential.
Framing Tendencies: Candid construction-site and yard snapshots balanced against wide farmland-and-new-road establishing shots; simple, unposed eye-level framing.
Emotional Tone: Optimism, fresh starts, modest ambition, small-town continuity.
Material Language: Fresh blacktop and gravel, raw framed lumber and plywood, wire garden fencing, staked young trees, older fieldstone and clapboard alongside new vinyl and aluminum siding.
Color Relationships: Warm amber late-day field light, cool pale spring morning tones, muted farmhouse greens and browns against the raw tan of freshly graded lots.
Visual Storytelling: A road that didn't exist a few years earlier, curving through fields that still mostly do — the specific, brief moment a place is becoming what it will be, not yet fully either.

name: 1992 PARADISE VALLEY HIGH SCHOOL HIJINKS
message: Take a picture and transform it into a candid, zaney moment from 1992 at Horizon High School in Paradise Valley, Arizona, featuring early 90s teenagers engaging in off-the-wall high school hijinks without smartphones. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Convert the scene into an authentic early 1990s high school environment, filled with period-accurate fashion (oversized sweaters, graphic tees, high-waisted denim, neon windbreakers), vintage campus architecture, and wild teen antics. Include references to Horizon High School, such as the Horizon Huskies strong dog mascot, gym sporting events (wrestling, volleyball, badminton, bleachered stands), drama club theatrical chaos, science club experiments with bubbling beakers, or stadium shenanigans. IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Retain the facial structure, distinct features, age, and recognizable expressions of the primary subjects while seamlessly dressing them in authentic 1992 high school attire and placing them into the energetic scene. COMPOSITION: Frame as a candid, chaotic snapshot, capturing dynamic action, spontaneous laughter, or mid-hijink reactions with a wide or medium field of view. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS: Emulate analog media formats of 1992, including square Polaroid prints, color-shifting Kodak Disc camera snapshots, washed-out 35mm point-and-shoot prints, or scanline-heavy 360p VHS camcorder stills with date stamps ('09/24/92'). NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Modern smartphones, flat-screen monitors, post-2000s clothing or haircuts, modern digital camera clarity, 4K crispness, modern athletic gear, clean polished studio lighting. RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATIONS: Mix analog media textures (polaroid borders, VHS noise, flash bloom) with specific high school hijink locations (gym bleachers, science labs, hallway lockers, sports mats). CREATIVE STRATEGY: Focus on raw, unscripted energy, nostalgic 90s southwest suburban teenage freedom, and quirky school spirit. VISUAL DNA: 1992 Arizona high school aesthetic, Horizon Huskies mascot sightings, vintage media artifacts, flash photography glares, authentic non-digital teenage interactions.

name: AVEDON CLASSY COLOR
message: Take a picture and transform it into a stark, emotionally raw, full-color studio portrait inspired by the iconic fashion editorial photography of Richard Avedon. CORE TRANSFORMATION: Isolate the subject against a seamless, pale blush-pink (#f9edf0) or warm champagne (#e6c8b7) studio backdrop with no horizon line or extraneous environmental distractions. Render the scene in vibrant, high-key studio color defined by an warm, sophisticated palette: deep emerald green (#1c3934), rich espresso darks (#261311), cognac (#c3955b), and amber accents (#ba6a36). IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Maintain precise facial feature proportions, bone structure, skin texture, and unique anatomical characteristics while capturing an intimate, vulnerable, or striking psychological moment. COMPOSITION: Frame as a tight headshot, three-quarter portrait, or full-length standing study with strong graphic lines, sharp contrast, and an unvarnished human presence. LIGHTING & COLOR: Emulate large-format view camera clarity with razor-sharp micro-contrast and punchy electronic flash. Utilize direct key lighting casting tight, defined shadows under facial features and jawlines, catching luminous natural skin tones. Wardrobe and styling should feature deep emerald and dark espresso tailoring or drapery contrasted against warm cognac and amber leather accents. NEGATIVE PROMPTS: Black and white, monochrome, gray scale, cluttered or naturalistic background scenery, soft romantic blur, over-retouched plastic skin, neon light, low-contrast washed colors. MASTER PROMPT RULE: If a master prompt specifies a particular subject, pose, setting, mood, or artistic direction—PRIORITIZE and USE that information while applying this transformation.
